item.title: School districts face a back-to-school math problem: The high price of diesel

item.title: Hollywood's summer box office is glowing, but the numbers come with startling caveats
item.description: Theaters have had something for everyone this summer, and fans are paying top dollar for premium formats like IMAX. There are also fewer moviegoers, fewer movies and fewer screens than there were pre-COVID.
